heading.title: Certificate numbering
heading.description: Numbers come from a counter for this institute, so they are sequential and never repeat. Choose the shape below, and where the count starts.

format.label: Format
format.hint: Anything outside { } is printed as-is. Click a value below to add it.

padding.label: Number width
padding.hint: Digits in a bare <1>{SEQ}</1>. Past this width numbers get longer rather than starting over.

suffix.label: Suffix (optional)
suffix.hint: Only printed where your format has <1>{SUFFIX}</1>.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.hint: The prefix set beside this field

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.hint: The suffix set beside this field

courseCode.label: Course code
courseCode.hint: Blank for courses with no code

seriesStart.title: Where the series starts
seriesStart.issuedInfo: This institute has issued up to #{{issued}}. The next certificate takes #{{next}}.
seriesStart.noneIssued: No certificate has been issued from this counter yet.

startField.label: Start numbering from
startField.hint: Set this if your certificates continue from paper records or another system — enter 1500 and the next one issued is #1500.

resetField.label: Restart the count each year
resetField.on: Back to the start every 1 January
resetField.hint: Off keeps counting: #1500 in {{year}} is followed by #1501 next year.

startFromIgnored.title: #{{start}} has already been issued, so this start number is ignored.
startFromIgnored.body: Numbering continues from #{{next}}. Numbers are never reused — #{{start}} is on a certificate somebody already holds. Choose a number above #{{issued}} to move the series forward.

noYearToken.title: This format has no year in it, but the count restarts each year.
noYearToken.body: January's first certificate would repeat a number already issued. Add <1>{YYYY}</1> to the format, or turn the yearly restart off.

noSequence.title: This format has no counter, so every certificate would get the same number.
noSequence.body: Add <1>{SEQ}</1> where the number should go — typing digits yourself prints those exact digits every time. Until you do, the counter is added at the end so numbers stay unique.

info.resetRestart: The count restarts each January, so it will begin at #{{start}} again next year. Turn the yearly restart off for one continuous series.
info.footer: Changing the format affects certificates issued from now on. The counter itself only ever moves forward — numbers already issued are never reused, which is why a start number below #{{min}} has no effect.
